equity_bridge.item: Investment securities (cross-shareholdings, listed at fair value) -- matching asset for excluded dividend income
equity_bridge.note: JPY42,045m at 2025-12-31 (5214.T_Annual_FY2025.txt:524) less ~JPY3bn book value sold in 9M FY2026 (H1 proceeds 7,095 vs gain 4,933 = ~2.2bn book; Q3 gain ~1.96bn implies ~1bn more). Quarterly BS lumps securities into 'Other' investments (59,762). EGP2028 targets reducing cross-shareholdings, so realisability is management policy.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: base-case 10-year average revenue growth (~2.2%); equity 5yr CAGR (0.8%) is depressed by JPY90bn of buybacks since FY2018 and the FY2023 impairment, and the EPS 5yr CAGR (19.4%) runs from a FY2020 mid-cycle base to the FY2025 peak -- neither is a forward growth rate.
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR 0.8% vs EPS 5yr CAGR 19.4% and revenue 5yr CAGR 5.1%: divergence >30%. Cause is cycle timing (FY2020 base -> FY2025 peak) plus buyback-driven equity shrinkage, not a data error. Selected rate ignores both.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF series = reported FCF - SBC - interest income. FY2025 22,191; FY2024 34,112; FY2023 -31,270 (negative); FY2022 -29,156 (negative, G10.5 capex JPY60bn); FY2021 33,992; FY2020 21,980. 3yr FCF CAGR undefined (FY2022 base negative). 11-year average reported FCF is ~JPY13bn/yr (4% of revenue): the business is furnace-capex heavy and owner FCF is structurally a small fraction of EBITDA. SBC is immaterial so the SBC-adjusted and reported CAGRs coincide.

scenario_narratives.base: Mid-cycle normalisation, not a rebound to FY2025. FY2026 lands on the cut guidance (sales JPY300bn, OP JPY20bn) as electric-melting conversion, periodic repairs and the US composites restructuring depress the year. From FY2027 the restructuring laps, semiconductor/data-centre electronics and low-dielectric fiber grow, displays follow panel-area growth at flat-to-falling prices, and margins climb to a 17.5% EBITDA / ~7.7% OP mid-cycle -- the FY2015-FY2025 average, not the 12.5% EGP2028 target. Capex stays at the 10-11% of sales the furnace fleet has historically required, so owner FCF is ~4-5% of sales at maturity. Terminal value capped at 13x year-10 owner FCF (cyclical cap).
scenario_narratives.bull: EGP2028 delivered late. All-electric melting cuts display unit cost, G10.5 share grows, WSG glass wafers, probe-card substrates and low-dielectric glass fiber scale into AI/data-centre demand, pharma tubing moves past start-up losses. Sales ~JPY360bn by FY2030 with 21% EBITDA (~11% OP) held rather than visited, i.e. the FY2017/FY2021/FY2025 peak margin becomes the run-rate. Even so, the JPY400bn FY2028 target is not reached.
scenario_narratives.bear: The structural-decline reading of display glass. Chinese substrate makers close the quality gap at G8.5/G10.5, Corning defends share on price, panel utilisation stays sub-80%, and NEG's electric-melting investment buys cost parity rather than margin. Composites keep losing money in the US, energy/raw-material inflation is absorbed. OP margin settles ~4.7% (the FY2019/FY2024 level) on flat sales; because capex cannot fall below D&A for long, owner FCF is near zero through the explicit period and the equity is worth little more than net cash plus the securities portfolio.

valuation_philosophy.summary: A furnace-capex-heavy specialty-glass cyclical valued on mid-cycle owner FCF, not on FY2025 peak earnings and not on book value. The engine charges SBC (immaterial), strips interest and dividend income from the flows and adds net cash and the cross-shareholding portfolio back in the bridge, deducts NCI once, discounts JPY flows at a JPY rate (8.5%), and caps the terminal value at 13x owner FCF. The price sits at ~0.74x book; the DCF explains the discount as a sub-cost-of-capital return on the asset base rather than a mispricing. Buybacks (JPY20bn/yr, JPY100bn EGP2028 plan) are value-neutral in the engine but would raise per-share value if executed below intrinsic value.
key_risks_to_valuation: Display glass pricing and panel-maker utilisation -- ~45% of sales, the swing factor in every cycle since FY2015
Chinese substrate makers (Tunghsu, CGC) reaching G8.5/G10.5 quality and Corning's price response
Capex intensity: all-electric melting conversion and furnace rebuilds; terminal capex is set roughly equal to D&A, which is the assumption that most moves the terminal value
Energy and raw-material cost pass-through; FX (yen weakness helps overseas sales, hurts imported energy)
US composites restructuring duration and any further impairment of the display asset base (FY2023 precedent)
Execution of EGP2028 growth businesses (WSG, low-dielectric glass fiber, pharma tubing) -- upside only in the bull case
Realisability of the JPY39bn cross-shareholding portfolio carried in the bridge at book

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 4323-8377 JPY
data_sources.financials: 5214.T_Metrics.csv (FY2015-FY2025 annual, quarterlies to 9M FY2026, JPY millions, share counts normalised for the 5-for-1 consolidation of 2017-07-01); Q3 FY2026 tanshin (5214.T_Quarterly_Q3-2026.txt) for the 2026-09-30 balance sheet, share counts and reaffirmed FY2026 forecast; FY2025 tanshin and results presentation for segment split, capex/D&A plan and EGP2028 targets; FY2025 annual report for the buyback program
data_sources.qualitative: No Analysis.json at build time; business context from info.json profile, the FY2025 results presentation (EGP2028 progress), and the Q3 FY2026 presentation (display demand, composites restructuring, low-dielectric fiber start-up)

inputs.share_count_basis: 89,523,246 issued less 17,069,363 treasury at 2026-09-30 (Q3 FY2026 tanshin) = 72,453,883. No dilutive potential shares (FY2025 tanshin per-share note). Held FLAT: SBC (JPY39m restricted stock) is expensed in the flows; the JPY20bn/yr buyback (up to 4m shares, Feb-Dec 2026) retires shares below the modelled count, which is upside not modelled -- buybacks are value-neutral in this engine.
inputs.debt_composition: 2026-09-30: short-term borrowings 15,674 + bonds payable 10,000 + long-term borrowings 52,802 = 78,476 (JPY m). Bonds/borrowings only; J-GAAP operating leases are expensed so no lease liability is added.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 Metrics.csv StockBasedComp (restricted-stock expense for directors, JPY39m); equity-award taxes nil (kpis EquityAwardTaxes = 0). SBC-zero market in practice: house and street coincide.
inputs.interest_income_note: FY2025 interest income JPY848m (5214.T_Annual_FY2025.txt:596), stripped because net cash (JPY29.7bn) exceeds the owner-FCF base. Dividend income on the cross-shareholding portfolio is non-operating under J-GAAP and never enters the EBITDA build; the matching asset is added in equity_bridge.
inputs.buyback_note: FY2025 purchase of treasury shares JPY20,003m (5214.T_Annual_FY2025.txt:737); FY2024 JPY28,105m; FY2023 JPY11,899m. EGP2028 plans JPY100bn cumulative; FY2026 program up to JPY20bn / 4m shares (Feb 9 - Dec 23, 2026), JPY10,002m spent to June 30, 2026. Dividends FY2025 JPY10,643m (DPS 150), FY2026 planned DPS 160 (DOE 3% target).
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-30T06:30:00Z (TSE regular close 30-Oct-2026, 15:30 JST; last close before the 31-Oct valuation date, not an after-hours print)
inputs.wacc_rationale: JPY-denominated flows discounted at a JPY-built rate. Risk-free: 10y JGB ~1.8% (Oct-2026, BoJ normalisation; approximate, not fetched). ERP 6.0%, beta ~1.15 for a display-glass cyclical -> cost of equity ~8.7%. Pre-tax cost of debt ~1.5% (0.9-1.0% after tax), debt/(debt+equity) ~18% at market -> computed WACC ~7.3%. House reference for JPY industrials is ~9% (3116.T, 7313.T); 8.5% is used as the house rate shaded 50bp for the net-cash balance sheet and investment-grade funding. Risk is charged ONCE: the same 8.5% applies to all three scenarios and cyclicality lives in the scenario flows and weights, not in a WACC premium. The sensitivity grid spans 6.5-10.5% so the pure-CAPM 7.3% is visible.
inputs.lease_treatment: J-GAAP filer; operating leases are expensed inside operating profit and no IFRS-16-style lease liability exists. No lease adjustment to flows and none in net debt (treatment is effectively (B) by construction).
inputs.nci_treatment: Flows are consolidated (100% of subsidiaries); non-controlling interests JPY3,757m at 2026-09-30 deducted once in equity_bridge. NCI share of profit is trivial (JPY311m in 9M FY2026) so the leakage is immaterial either way.
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF DCF, component route (operating company, non-US cyclical -> owner-fcf.md + owner-fcf-adaptations.md). First valuation of this ticker (no MEMORY entry). Fresh build, no reconciliation. CYCLE POSITION: FY2025 (net income JPY29.6bn, OP margin 11.0%) was a peak year comparable to FY2017/FY2021; FY2023 (OP -3.7%, net loss JPY26.2bn on display impairments) and FY2024 (OP margin 2.0%) were the trough. The FY2026 forecast was cut on 31-Jul-2026 from sales JPY320bn / OP JPY33bn to JPY300bn / OP JPY20bn / NP JPY15bn (reaffirmed in the Q3 tanshin; 9M OP JPY16.0bn vs JPY24.3bn prior year) on electric-melting conversion costs, periodic furnace repairs, raw-material/energy inflation, medical-glass start-up costs and panel-maker production cuts. The base case therefore does NOT extrapolate FY2025: year 1 is the cut guidance (EBITDA margin 15.3% = OP 20bn + D&A 26bn on 300bn), and margins recover only to a mid-cycle 17.5% EBITDA / ~7.7% OP (the FY2015-FY2025 average OP margin is 7.2%, 8.3% ex the FY2023 impairment year), not to the 12.5% OP margin EGP2028 target. CAPEX: glass melting is furnace-rebuild intensive; cash capex averaged 10.5% of revenue and D&A 10.6% over FY2015-FY2025, so terminal capex (10.0%) is set roughly equal to D&A (9.8%). FY2026 capex plan is JPY45bn (all-electric melting, low-dielectric D2 glass fiber), modelled at 13% cash. Working capital: receivables + inventories (JPY140bn) less trade payables (JPY33bn) is ~35% of sales, so growth consumes cash; wc_capture -30%. Segment: single reportable segment (glass); displays ~45% of sales, electronics ~12%, composites/medical/heat-resistance/buildings the rest. Price JPY4,979 vs net assets JPY485bn (P/B ~0.74x) -- the DCF-vs-book gap is the low mid-cycle return on a furnace-heavy asset base, not a data error.
inputs.guidance_fy2026: Sales 300.0bn (-3.7%), OP 20.0bn (-41.4%), ordinary profit 25.0bn, profit attributable 15.0bn (-49.4%), EPS 202.93; capex ~45bn, D&A ~26bn; DPS 160. Source: 5214.T_Quarterly_Q3-2026.txt:87-101, 269-301; 5214.T_Presentation_FY2025.txt:340-349.

bear.rationale: Display glass pricing erodes further as Chinese substrate makers (Tunghsu, Caihong/CGC) reach G8.5+/G10.5 quality and Corning defends share; panel makers keep utilisation below 80%; the US composites restructuring bleeds longer; energy and raw-material inflation is not passed through. Margins settle at the FY2019/FY2024 level (~4.7% OP) with no return to the peak. Furnace capex cannot be cut below D&A for long, so owner FCF is near zero in the explicit years -- this is the path on which the business earns below its cost of capital indefinitely.

base.growth_rationale: Y1 = July-2026 cut guidance (JPY300bn, -3.7%). Y2-Y4 recover 3-4% as the US composites restructuring laps, low-dielectric glass fiber and semiconductor/data-centre electronics ramp, and displays track panel-area growth with flat-to-down pricing. Fades to 1.5% (JPY nominal) -- EGP2028's JPY400bn FY2028 sales target is not reached in the base (JPY331bn).
base.margin_rationale: Y1 15.3% EBITDA = guided OP 20bn + D&A 26bn on 300bn. Mid-cycle 17.5% EBITDA (~7.7% OP at 9.8% D&A) sits between the FY2024 trough (11.7%) and the FY2025 peak (18.7%); the FY2015-FY2025 EBITDA margin average is 17.9% but on a higher D&A base. Deliberately below the FY2028 12.5%-OP target.
base.capex_rationale: FY2026 plan JPY45bn (15% accrual; 13% cash). Glides to 10% = long-run cash capex/revenue (10.5%, FY2015-25). D&A rises from 7.8% (FY2025, post-impairment base) toward 9.8% as the JPY45bn programme depreciates. Terminal capex ~= D&A.
base.tax_rationale: Japan statutory ~30.6%; FY2025 current tax 13.55bn on 41.9bn pre-tax = 32%. FY2024's 18% cash rate used FY2023 loss carryforwards and is not repeatable. Engine never credits tax on a loss.

bull.rationale: EGP2028 delivered a year or two late: all-electric melting lowers display cost per m2, G10.5 share gains, WSG glass wafers / probe-card substrates and low-dielectric fiber scale with AI data-centre demand, pharma tubing start-up costs roll off. Sales reach ~JPY360bn by FY2030 and EBITDA 21% (~11.3% OP, roughly the FY2017/FY2021/FY2025 peak margin sustained rather than visited).

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 13x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 30%: the FY2019/FY2024 margin world has recurred twice in a decade, display glass faces Chinese capacity, and management has just cut the current-year forecast by 40% six months after issuing it. Bull cut to 20% because it needs several independent things to go right (display pricing holds, electric-melting cost savings land, low-dielectric fiber and WSG both scale) and the company has never sustained an 11% OP margin for more than two consecutive years. Base 50%.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
